facts.fact: The ONS bulletin Démographie algérienne 2020 à 2023 (N°1030), imprint July 2024, reports 895,000 live births, 192,000 deaths and 278,000 marriages for 2023, and speaks of births falling below 900,000 'enregistrements', i.e. vital events from civil registration; as_of is the publication date (July 2024), the figures cover 2023.
